source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data transformation (PDF 134).

blocks.text: Saaf hone ke baad data ko aksar aisi shakal mein badalna hota hai jis par kaam aasan ho: format badalna, naye columns banana ya data ko mukhtalif tarteeb dena, ta ke analysis ya modelling ke liye munasib ho. Maslan grades ke saaf record ko har student ki qataar ki bajaye har class ke ausat ki shakal di ja sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Data transformation ki ek misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Marks se nikala 'percentage' column jorna, ya students ke grades ki list ko class ausat ki table banana.

items: Transformation: saaf data ka format badalna, columns jorna ya analysis ke liye dobara tarteeb.
